    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the near term, with true outcomes exceeding model values by 0.3-0.6 on average for the first 10-15 days",

    "Sentiment momentum is mismodeled - model under-responds to sustained positive sentiment by 10-20% in early periods",
    "Mean reversion is present in true outcomes but not captured in model, causing divergence in days 15-25",
    "Model successfully tracks outcomes better in the late period (days 20-30) where correlations improve significantly",
    "Sentiment effects are delayed and dampened in model - true outcomes show more sentiment-driven volatility than forecasted",
